newsitem.title: UK: Princess Diana to visit Angola land mine victims.
newsitem.headline: Princess Diana to visit Angola land mine victims.

text.p: Princess Diana is to visit the victims of landmines in war-torn Angola on behalf of the Red Cross, officials said on Sunday.
She is to fly to the Angolan capital of Luanda on January 13 and be taken to see a British operation to clear the millions of landmines planted in the country's 20-year-old civil war.
Diana, recently divorced from heir-to-the-throne Prince Charles, has the full approval of Queen Elizabeth and the Foreign Office for her five-day trip.
She has also agreed to attend the Red Cross charity premiere in London next month of Richard Attenborough's new film based on Ernest Heimngway's "A Farewell to Arms."
